artifacts.name: Ege 30
artifacts.description: A 15th-century manuscript leaf (Book of Hours) from the Otto Ege collection in the RIT Cary Graphic Arts Collection. Imaged across 16 wavelengths from UV through near-infrared by MISHA (Multispectral Imaging System for Historical Artifacts), an independent project of RIT's Cultural Heritage Imaging, Preservation, and Research program (rit.edu/chipr/misha) — not one of this project's own capture systems. Preliminary review found probable undertext visible under UV, indicating this leaf is a palimpsest.
